notes.title: Major Update

tags.feature: 1, improve the VR control mode, Now you can the use of virtual joystick and virtual throttle, while retaining the current touch mode, can be selected in the system options;
2. Enhance the clarity of VR head-mounted display, add the optimized buttons for monitor and VR head-mounted display, and optimize it according to its own display device;
3, Add system options, you can customize the game, video, audio, control and VR, support joystick;
4, Daytime training adds new aerial refueling training content;
